talking_points: Nvidia is now investing in nearly every major AI player, including a fresh $3bn stake in Meta tied to its new Muse AI agent.
Microsoft is offering buyouts to up to 60,000 staff just as it pours billions into AI infrastructure, and Meta is raising $95bn to do the same.
Anthropic's IPO filing shows just how expensive it is to build frontier AI: huge revenue growth, but an eye-watering loss to match.
